PLACING persists the placement request and calls customer-ordering POST /checkout with Idempotency-Key equal to the sessionId. ConfirmSession with the PSP payment method token (never a card number). AUTHORIZING calls customer-payments POST /payment-authorizations (key `<sessionId>:auth:<attempt>`, the attempt counter grows on every retry after a decline; allocations per group); the authorized amount must equal the quote total (ErrAuthorizationMismatch). PLACING persists the placement request and calls customer-ordering POST /checkout with Idempotency-Key equal to the sessionId. Outcomes: 200 with the session in a definitive state (COMPLETED, DECLINED, REQUOTE_REQUIRED with requotedOffers after a successful void, or FAILED after a void plus an alert for a contract bug); 202 while the place-order outcome is unknown (the session stays PLACING; poll GET /checkout-sessions/\{sessionId\}). A DECLINED session may be confirmed again with another token while the price quote is valid.
